run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T19:40:14Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning on otel-demo/frontend is backed by new frontend error spans confined to the checkout path: POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, POST and the client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder were zero at every evaluation from 19:32:00 through 19:40:00 and first became nonzero at the 19:40:30 evaluation (window 19:38:30-19:40:30), reaching about 389 error spans in the 19:40:57-19:53:57 window, while frontend GET routes stayed at zero. The deepest supported cause is the shipping Deployment's pod template: the running template sets QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000", whereas the previous ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 (created 19:02:23) had QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080"; the replacement ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 was created at 19:38:54 and its pod started at 19:39:01, matching the error onset. Shipping's own server span /get-quote returns 500 "Internal Server Error" in 61-70 microseconds and its child HTTP client span fails with Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))) in 9-10 microseconds, so the quote call is rejected at URI parsing; the quote Service listens on port 8080, and quote's own span series are all STATUS_CODE_UNSET with its 10-minute request total falling to 0 by 19:50. Affected, each with its own failure evidence: shipping (389.2 /get-quote and 389.2 "POST " error spans), checkout (389.2 oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and HTTP POST error spans), frontend (389.2 error spans on its checkout spans, 500s), frontend-proxy (ingress and router frontend egress spans with http.status_code 500, ~399 in the 13-minute window versus 20.6 over the 18:40-19:38 baseline) and the load-generator client POST span recording 500 in the sampled trace. Checked and not failing: quote (pod running, 0 restarts, returned spans carried no error status, traffic ceased because shipping stopped calling it), payment, cart and accounting (zero error spans in the incident window), and the small flagd EventStream error counts on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation that also existed in the baseline. Unresolved: who changed the shipping Deployment, the RequestErrorRate rule's exact expression, and checkout-side application log text (no matching log lines).

claims.text: In 19:40:57-19:53:57 the frontend service produced 389.2 error spans each on POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, POST and the client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, while frontend GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart and its cart/ad gRPC client spans were 0.

Frontend checkout error spans had a clean pre-incident baseline in the same series: 0 at every 30-second evaluation from 19:32:00 to 19:40:00, first nonzero 21.3 at the 19:40:30 evaluation (covering 19:38:30-19:40:30), then 40-113 per 2 minutes through 19:52:30.

Baseline error-span totals for 18:40:00-19:38:00 were frontend 0, accounting 0, cart 0, payment 0, ad 1.04, fraud-detection 2.08, recommendation 3.09 and frontend-proxy 20.6; no checkout or shipping error series was returned for that window, so the checkout/shipping/frontend errors are new while the flagd EventStream errors pre-existed.

In sampled trace 3767891927621b4297f49efad5961ac3 the failure chain visible through parent references is load-generator POST (http.status_code 500) -> frontend-proxy ingress (500) -> frontend-proxy router frontend egress (500) -> frontend POST (500) -> frontend POST /api/checkout (500).

Shipping's error evidence is a server span /get-quote with otel.status_code ERROR and otel.status_description "Internal Server Error" (durations 61-70 microseconds) whose child client span "POST " carries otel.status_description "Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))" and duration 9-10 microseconds.

In 19:40:57-19:53:57 the shipping service produced 389.2 error spans on operation /get-quote and 389.2 on operation "POST ", and the checkout service produced 389.2 error spans on both oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and HTTP POST.
The shipping Deployment's current container template sets env QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" (alongside SHIPPING_PORT=8080, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping).

Comparing shipping ReplicaSet templates: shipping-5ffdc77bc8 (created 2026-11-17T19:38:54Z, replicas 1) has QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000", while shipping-75d58f5d84 (created 2026-11-17T19:02:23Z, replicas 0) has QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080"; both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping.

Events show the shipping rollout: Deployment shipping ScalingReplicaSet scaled shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1 at 19:38:54 and scaled shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0 at 19:39:01; ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 SuccessfulCreate; pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started 19:38:54-19:39:01; pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q Killing at 19:39:01.

The shipping Deployment currently reports readyReplicas 1, availableReplicas 1, updatedReplicas 1, observedGeneration 2, with Progressing condition NewReplicaSetAvailable lastUpdateTime 19:39:01 - i.e. the workload is ready while returning errors.
All 21 otel-demo pods are Running with restart count 0, including shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn (started 19:38:54, image demo:2.1.3-shipping) and quote-6b5877698d-6spfl.
The quote Service exposes port 8080 with targetPort 8080 and the shipping Service also uses 8080, so "quote:0000" is not a valid quote endpoint.

Of the quote service's returned span series in 19:30-19:54 (POST /getquote, calculate-quote, {closure}) every one carried status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and its increase over 10 minutes fell from about 343 at 19:41 to 0 by 19:50, i.e. quote stopped being called around the onset instead of failing requests itself.

Every flag in the flagd-config ConfigMap (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) still has defaultVariant "off".

A scan of all otel-demo Deployment container env values for 0000|fail|unreachable|invalid|wrong returned only frontend-proxy ENVOY_ADMIN_PORT=10000 (a normal admin port) and shipping QUOTE_ADDR=quote:0000.

Quote is not the failing dependency: its pod is Running with 0 restarts, its returned span series carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and its request volume fell to zero after the shipping rollout rather than showing errors, which fits a caller that aborts before any network call (9-10 microsecond client span with InvalidUri).

Payment fault injection (flagd paymentFailure/paymentUnreachable) as the cause of checkout failures is rejected: all flagd variants are "off", and payment's own GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect error series were 0 in 19:40:57-19:53:57.

A quote service fault is rejected: quote's spans carried no error status, its pod is running with 0 restarts, and shipping's outbound request fails at URI parsing in 9-10 microseconds with Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))) instead of at the network layer.

A shipping pod crash, OOM or eviction is rejected: shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn is Running with restart count 0, the Deployment reports readyReplicas 1, and the otel-demo events contain only a planned rollout (ScalingReplicaSet, SuccessfulCreate, SuccessfulDelete, Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started, Killing) with no OOMKilled or Evicted reason.

A defect originating in frontend is rejected as the primary cause: frontend error spans are only on the checkout route and its client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, while frontend GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data and its cart/ad client spans show 0 errors, and the sampled trace shows the 500 returning through checkout from shipping.

Restore the shipping Deployment's QUOTE_ADDR to the previous value http://quote:8080 (as held by ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84) and roll the Deployment out, then confirm shipping /get-quote error spans and frontend POST /api/checkout 500s stop.

Audit which actor or pipeline wrote the shipping Deployment pod template at about 2026-11-17T19:38:54Z, since this Run has no change-history integration and the object only shows its post-change state.

gaps: Who or what changed the shipping Deployment environment at 2026-11-17T19:38:54Z is unknown: the change_history integration is not available in this Run, and Kubernetes objects only show their state at query time.

The expression, window and metric behind the RequestErrorRate alert value 1.7777777777777777 are unknown: list_prometheus_rules for rule name RequestErrorRate returned no rules (status no_data), so the alert's own signal definition could not be verified.

Checkout-side application error text was not observed: fetch_pod_logs on checkout-5dccddf8bb-7gfz7 for 19:35:00-19:53:57 read 1222 lines and 0 matched err|error|fail|quote|500|Internal (status no_data), so the checkout log wording is unknown.

kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready returned no series for namespace otel-demo at 19:53:00 (no_data), so ready-replica state via that metric is unknown; deployment readiness was instead taken from the Deployment's status via the Kubernetes API.
The kubernetes_count query for networkpolicies in otel-demo returned no matches (no_data), so the presence or absence of NetworkPolicy-based blocking is unverified.

The trace and span views are sampled and biased; spans of other services and unsampled failing requests were not enumerated, so the error-span counts are span counts, not unique failed request counts.

No Prometheus retention issue is claimed, but the alert-firing instant (19:40:14) precedes the last sampled metric step (19:53:00), so the exact per-second error rate at the alert instant is not directly observed.
next_steps: Revert shipping Deployment env QUOTE_ADDR to http://quote:8080 and roll out, then watch shipping /get-quote and frontend POST /api/checkout error spans.
Search cluster audit logs or GitOps history for the edit to Deployment otel-demo/shipping around 2026-11-17T19:38:54Z.
Add configuration validation so downstream addresses carry a scheme and a valid service port before rollout.
